1884904087.cause: LWE segfaults building a particle system from an old WE particle preset embedded in the scene.pkg
1884904087.note: Reproduces without our worker (`lp-scene-worker --lwe-smoke`, LWE's core alone). gdb: SIGSEGV in `CParticle::CParticle(CScene&, Particle const&)` +108 ← `CScene::dispatchObjectType` ← `CScene::createObject` ← `CScene::CScene` ← `Project::render` ← `wp_render_frame` (the first render = the renderer build), so patch 0004's build guard never sees it. The particle object uses `particles/presets/leaves2.json` (+ a child emitter `leaves2b.json`) shipped inside the item's scene.pkg. Same crash as 2047150134 (`leaves5.json`); dozens of other corpus scenes with particle systems (presets with or without `instanceoverride`) build fine.
1884904087.todo: Phase 6 — docs/TODO.md "LWE: CParticle segfault on embedded leaves presets"

2189783622.cause: an effect shader packaged in the scene fails to compile, LWE then drops the scene's only object
2189783622.note: One image object with two effects (godrays, foliagesway) whose shaders ship as old copies inside the scene.pkg. glslang rejects the packaged godrays fragment (`'v_Bounds' : undeclared identifier`, `missing #endif`), the object's setup fails (`Failed to setup object 13`) and LWE renders nothing for it — the scene is that one object, so every frame is black. Wallpaper Engine would show the image, at worst without the effect.

3233141951.cause: LWE reads a text object's `padding` as a number; this scene writes it as a "x y" string → an uncaught JSON exception aborts the load
3233141951.note: gdb: `nlohmann::json type_error 302 (type must be number, but is string)` thrown in `JsonExtensions::optional<int>` ← `ObjectParser::parseText` ← `WallpaperParser::parseObjects` ← `ProjectParser::parse` ← `wp_project_load_folder`; nothing catches it at the C API, so `terminate` → SIGABRT at every load: 4 crashes → broken (correct crash policy, but a load failure should not be a crash loop). Of the 45 corpus scenes with text objects exactly these two (3233141951, 3326873240) have a string `padding` (`"32.00000 32.00000"`); the 43 with a number get past the text parser. Reproduced with `--lwe-smoke`.
3233141951.todo: Phase 6 — docs/TODO.md "LWE: text `padding` as a vec2 string" + "LWE: catch exceptions at the wp_* C API"
